subject: Privileged access sunset + severance terms for Ilya — coordination
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Privileged access sunset + severance terms for Ilya — coordination

Vivek,

Per our 7:30 sync: we need to finalize the severance offer and the access revocation timeline for Ilya Petrov (ENG) — termination effective 10/09. Attached is the draft term sheet and an access-sunset checklist I pulled from HR templates. Key asks for you / Markus / Monica:  

- Confirm business-critical handoffs (customers, on-call, outstanding PRs) by EOD 10/06.
- Approve proposed severance weeks and continuation of benefits in the draft.
- Confirm whether we keep GitHub/org admin removals delayed until after knowledge capture (up to 48 hrs) or do immediate removal at termination. HR prefers a 24-hour window.

I'll route the final T&C to legal after approvals. If external counsel is needed for the term sheet we can loop Erin.

Laura Bennett
People Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
(Attachment: draft_severance_term_sheet_v1.pdf, access-sunset-checklist.xlsx)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access sunset + severance terms for Ilya — coordination

Thanks Laura — quick context from my side: Ilya has been on the Acme Biotech integration (primary POC Tim Roberts). There are two outstanding tasks: a priority hotfix (PR #1298) scheduled for 10/07 and the integration postmortem for last release. Monica — can your team cover the customer touchpoints if we revoke access immediately?

On severance: the draft weeks look fine to me, but I'd like to reserve one week of base pay contingent on a knowledge transfer completion sign-off (template attached). If we make admin removals immediate we risk blocking the hotfix — can we do scoped access removal (org admin -> remove; repo push -> keep until 10/10) so CI builds still run? Markus, is that technically safe?

Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
(Attachment: knowledge_capture_template.docx)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access sunset + severance terms for Ilya — coordination

We should be conservative on admin rights. Practical plan I recommend:

1) Remove org-level admin and billing access immediately upon termination.
2) Create a short-lived service account/token for the build pipeline so PRs targeting 1298 can be merged and CI will run; token expires 72 hours after termination.
3) Keep repo-level write access for Ilya until 48 hours post-termination to allow the hotfix to land, provided he signs the KT checklist.

I'll ask infra to provision the temp token and add the expiry. Monica — let me know if that works for the customer side.

Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering
markus_klein@redwood.ai
(Attachment: none)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged access sunset + severance terms for Ilya — coordination

Vivek — we can cover Tim (Acme) for the hotfix window. Plan: Monica will be primary contact (tim.roberts@acme-biotech.com), and Diego from CS will be on backup. Request for the CS cover: please send a one-paragraph handoff for Tim and a prioritized list of outstanding action items.

On the knowledge capture: we need screenshots of the integration config and the postmortem notes. If Ilya provides the KT by 10/09 noon, CS will accept the sign-off and take over. Otherwise we escalate to the on-call rotation and may bill back for remediation work.

Monica Patel
Sr. Customer Success Manager
monica_patel@redwood.ai
(Attachment: none)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Updated term sheet + route to legal

Thanks all — I've updated the draft per Vivek/Markus suggestions:

- 8 weeks base pay, with 1 week conditional pending KT sign-off (template included).
- Health benefits continuation for 60 days.
- Immediate org-admin and billing removal at termination; repo write access retained up to 48 hrs with infra-issued temp token (as Markus proposed).

I'm attaching the new PDF and will route to Erin Hartman (external counsel) for a quick review. If there are no issues we aim to have the DocuSign packet to Ilya by EOD 10/06 for signature.

(Attachment: draft_severance_term_sheet_v1.pdf updated)

From: erin.hartman@hartmanlaw.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Updated term sheet + route to legal

Laura / team — reviewed the updated term sheet. A couple of quick notes:

- Conditional week tied to KT sign-off is acceptable; recommend a one-sentence acceptance clause defining what "completed KT" means (deliverables + recipient sign-off).
- Add a short non-disparagement clause and a mutual release paragraph to avoid future claims.

I can insert those two clauses and return the PDF by EOD; please confirm you'd like me to make those edits directly in the DocuSign packet.

Erin Hartman
Hartman Law LLP
erin.hartman@hartmanlaw.com
